objective: Make final user-facing earnings transparent across BUKLOD Personal, Organization and Cluster Home surfaces and the one canonical unified Profit First payout entry: separate finalized revenue-share, first-line referral, one-time referral, and safely funded System Admin cash from preliminary AdMob and group/community money. Remove misleading referral-only withdrawal label; do not enable cash controls or OTA.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Production Supabase BUKLOD Connect 2026-11-09 includes official private AdMob Nov estimate amount_minor=864 with 30% Community pool=259 centavos, not cash; production get_my_buklod_financial_earnings_breakdown_v1 has own-user `lifetime_earned.user_pool_php`, `first_line_php`, `referral_reward_php`, newly added `admin_funded_reward_php`, and PF AVAILABLE/RESERVED/PAID wallet. Previous merged PR #596 commit 00c2e3aaa058196124ffd9d97e73d85e4d9969fc already mounted unified personal earnings on Personal, Organization, Cluster Homes, separate scope fund. Previous merged PR #597 commit 263450644ecdb3b79410ecfebfcc0eda879821f8 installed admin funding logic and read-only private source field. Production DB verified grant_enabled=false, economics_enabled=false, withdrawal_enabled=false, payout_processing_enabled=false, recorded_budgets=0, transfers=0, cash_ledger_rows=0. Existing canonical request_my_buklod_pf_withdrawal_v2 reserves entire PF AVAILABLE balance atomically, with authenticated payout profile, minimum and replay protection. Baseline app payout confirmation misleadingly said Request Full Referral Balance. This PR changes only UI/readability and tests, no release artifact is asserted deployed.
acceptanceChecks: Show four disjoint lifetime funded source categories on all three already-mounted Home cards: settled revenue/user pool, first-line, one-time referral, verified funded admin reward.
Retain available/reserved/paid balances and use only the actual canonical PF available cash for one withdrawal door
Preserve privacy: no cross-user data, no account selector, no direct use of private tables, no client money writes
Preserve source-backed preliminary AdMob estimation and group funds separate from withdrawable personal balances
Correct misleading referral-only confirmation to all available finalized cash in PF payout UI; exclude pending estimates and points
No finance config activation, cash transfer, production OTA, new AAB or web deployment
All required CI and focused test gates must pass for RC source readiness; device acceptance and exact production OTA require separate verified release evidence
chosenApproach: Minimal UI-only refinement on merged canonical Home card and payout/earnings pages; read back private server-reported source categories and remove referral-only wording while preserving the existing full balance withdrawal RPC, review gates and noncash distinction.
selectionRationale: Existing merged code and tested read-only RPCs already implement user-scoped gross/pool source visibility and funded admin reward source. There is no reason to change cash storage, financial accrual logic, or add a second withdrawal flow. A single UI clarity change avoids misleading reward users and keeps compatibility.
alternativeApproaches: Reimplement withdrawals to merge wallets: rejected because Profit First V3 already withdraws unified finalized cash, and separate new withdrawal would risk double reservation
Mix pending/referral/noncash AdMob into available cash: rejected because it would fabricate withdrawable funds
Display existing server-authenticated lifetime origins and correct explanatory labels: chosen
preserveBehaviors: Production economics, reward grants, payout processing and withdrawal activation remain OFF
No changes to Supabase backend, RLS, RPCs, tables, financial history, point system or user balances
Noncash QMP and AdMob estimates remain non-withdrawable
Organization and Cluster fund never becomes personal cash by viewing the same Home
One PF full-available-cash withdrawal with minimum and manual review unchanged
All previous BUKLOD Home cards, Connect, Cluster/Org navigation and performance kept
Consolidated OTA remains unpublished pending RC and exact artifact verification
